decision_communication: Eligibility and case-specific cautions sent to coordinating agent before this auditor received or inspected new pocket outcomes; no new prediction outcomes were used.
source_cohort: AAV9 plus all seven cases already frozen in benchmarks/external_cohort.json; no post-outcome case selection.

required_criteria: A primary structural publication explicitly assigns a noncovalent glycan-recognition surface or anchor.
Deposited modeled ligand coordinates correspond to the pinned reference representation; target residue/chain identity is explicit.
Deposited validation diagnostics are inspected per selected ligand copy and their gaps/outliers retained.

Receptor representation, omitted constructs/subunits and assembly discrepancies are explicit. Prediction input uses the entire released bound receptor or complete deposited capsid without ligand-derived crops.
The accepted claim is approximate recovery of that published modeled site; no unseen map certification, atomic pose quality, biological specificity or independent-family generalization.
eligibility_policy.family_assignment_status: Descriptive source-family labels; sequence, fold, training-set and homolog independence not audited. SP-D and codakine are both C-type lectins.
eligibility_policy.primary_site_target: Published modeled ligand footprint for an operational site-location comparison; incomplete ligand references measure only modeled footprint.
eligibility_policy.endpoint_provenance: PROTOCOL.md center-to-nearest-native-heavy-atom Top-1/Top-5 at 4 A, with 3/5 A sensitivity and residue coverage; no new threshold chosen from outcomes.
interpretation_limits: A site-only accepted case may have an uncertain exact atom placement.
Residue-overlap targets are model-derived geometric diagnostics, not independently certified atom contacts.
Full released receptor does not mean complete biological assembly or full-length protein.
Holo protein conformation can expose a site and this remains a holo site-localization experiment.
All cases remain development references; no independent confirmatory or fold-split claims.

cases.source_family_description: AAV9 parvovirus capsid; 60 symmetry-related glycan sites form one site class and one system-level observation.
cases.eligibility_reason: Penzes et al. Results/Fig. 4 localize ligand-dependent density at the previously mapped galactose-recognition pocket near the threefold spike wall, corroborating an approximate site. Sixty deposited GAL positions represent one symmetry-equivalent site class.
cases.atomic_and_context_cautions: The paper calls glycan density poorly defined and models ring-shaped beta-galactose; Methods report dosing N-acetylgalactosamine whereas the deposited component is GAL. The article associates 7MTZ with 2.7 A while current deposition reports 2.43 A. No deposited local ligand fit metrics in the archived validation, and all 60 GAL copies carry a torsion flag. This is not an independently certified atomic pose.

receptor_scope.prediction_representation: Ligand-stripped complete deposited 60-subunit capsid, materialized once; no reference-neighborhood crop.
receptor_scope.assembly_operator: Identity 1 over already expanded deposited 60-mer; do not expand twice.
receptor_scope.known_missing_biological_context: Ordered modeled capsid region only; disordered VP N-terminal regions and full cell-surface glycoconjugate are not represented.

evaluation_only.permitted_use: Evaluate only after ligand-free inputs and candidate ranks are frozen; no ligand sites or mutagenesis residues may define prediction sectors or crops.
evaluation_only.native_ligand_atom_rule: All 12 modeled GAL heavy atoms at each of 60 equivalent sites.
evaluation_only.contact_rule: Protein heavy atoms strictly less than 4.0 A from native GAL heavy atoms; geometric contact labels need not equal the paper biochemical direct-contact prose.
evaluation_only.representative_geometric_contact_descrip: GAL author A801 (label IB) contacts TRP503 on author A and ASN470/VAL473 on neighboring author I under the geometric 4 A rule.

cases.source_family_description: Goose-type lysozyme; a catalytic carbohydrate cleft, not a lectin-family fold split.
cases.eligibility_reason: Weaver et al. explicitly locate the noncovalent chitotriose in the catalytic B/C/D subsites. Exact deposited/released coordinate correspondence gives a published-site target despite weak ligand validation. This supports approximate site localization only.
cases.atomic_and_context_cautions: Published assignment corroborates the cleft, but RSCC 0.602-0.794 and the EDS/depositor R discrepancy do not independently validate any exact glycan pose. No density inspected.

validation_review.interpretation: Deposited report diagnostics reviewed; they support case-specific uncertainty statements, not map certification or a universal numerical pass threshold.

cases.source_family_description: Human galectin-3 carbohydrate-recognition domain; the N-terminal region of full-length galectin-3 is absent.
cases.eligibility_reason: Sorme et al. solve the galectin-3 CRD with LacNAc and compare its binding region with a substituted inhibitor. The GAL anchor has RSCC 0.902 and identifies the canonical CRD surface even though the NAG portion and entry-wide fit need caution.
cases.atomic_and_context_cautions: NAG RSCC 0.751 with clash/bond flags and EDS/depositor R discrepancy leave the full atomic pose unresolved. One released terminal oxygen differs from deposited coordinates, far from this site. No density inspected.

cases.source_family_description: One fucose-binding CBM47 from a Streptococcus pneumoniae GH98-associated modular protein; not the complete multivalent parent protein.

cases.atomic_and_context_cautions: Nine angle and two torsion flags are present in the four selected residues. Their atoms and local density have not been independently inspected, so atomic eligibility remains unresolved.

cases.source_family_description: Human surfactant protein D neck/CRD construct; one released chain versus the experimental homotrimer.
cases.eligibility_reason: Shrive et al. solve maltose-bound recombinant SP-D and describe carbohydrate recognition by the CRDs. The released A-chain site retains its recognition calcium and the selected deposited D-chain maltose maps exactly, with RSCC 0.849-0.961.
cases.atomic_and_context_cautions: The released receptor has one chain, whereas deposited assembly 1 and the paper describe a trimer. This is a full released-chain surface localization test, not a complete-assembly test; dry preparation and selected alternate conformers limit physical interpretation.

cases.source_family_description: Codakine C-type lectin; shares the broad C-type lectin fold category with SP-D, so these labels do not establish fold independence.
cases.eligibility_reason: Gourdine et al. identify the calcium-mediated N-glycan-recognition site and explicitly report that capping galactosides were not modeled. The seven deposited/released residues and their site map exactly; the resolved fragment can localize the binding surface.
cases.atomic_and_context_cautions: Only seven of the titled nine sugars are modeled; RSCC spans 0.700-0.939 with geometry flags. HYP91 is omitted from the released protein. The paper describes a disulfide dimer, but current assembly metadata is monomeric and an intermolecular Cys44 disulfide uses crystal operator 4_555. Complete biological context is unresolved.
